topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: The attic, they said, was a time capsule. Old trunks, faded letters, a dozen empty picture frames. I hauled myself up there, expecting another day of the forgettable, but something about those items... they had a whisper to them, a story left untold. Dust didn’t bother me—secrets did. I sifted through it all, hands careful, eyes sharper. Found a ledger, names and numbers, a few that made my eyebrows raise. This wasn’t just junk. This was a ledger of debts, maybe stolen, maybe not. But it was something. The homeowner watched me, a mix of curiosity and something else. I gave them a nod, a silent promise. I’d find out what these papers meant, and why they were hidden away. It’s the kind of case that gets under your skin, the kind that makes you earn your keep.
